rule_or_pattern: Drop lines flagged C:len_vs_book_high, C:cpp_vs_book_out or C:repeated_word, plus D:column_crossing_line/column_merge_line lines, and crops taller than ~1.4x the page's median line height. Also drop lines that repeat a word directly (regex: \b(\w{4,})\w*,? \1).
notes: Most random lines of this 1985 parliament record read correctly. A clear subset is wrong. In 37, 38 and 39 the label holds a single word ('προβλήματα', 'περιβάλλοντος', 'ότι και επιστημονικά το') that belongs to another line, under a full printed line, and 33 has 'μας βοήθησε' under a long line. Some labels double words: 19 'Σχετικό Σχετικά', 34 'χωροταξικό, χωροταξικό', 36 'εκσυγχρον εγκαταστασης, εκσυγχρονι'. Line 21 merges two columns, 27 takes text from the next line, and 22 adds a spurious 'ΑΧΙ'.
